<br> Welcome to my portfolio!

I’m Fiorella Guillén, a recent master’s graduate in **Urban Spatial Science** from UCL, with a background in architecture and urbanism. My work focuses on **sustainable urban development** and **spatial analysis**, and I’m passionate about using **data-driven** approaches to understand cities and inform better design and planning decisions.

Here, you’ll find examples of my academic and professional projects, from spatial data analysis to urban design and masterplanning.

Feel free to explore my projects, and don’t hesitate to reach out! <br><br> [Download Resumé](images/resume.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-light} [Download Portfolio](images/portfolio.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-light}
